estimation: OLS with intercept using raw daily returns, NOT excess-return CAPM; market price index versus adjusted stock returns
signal: completed W-FRI last session close; execute next market session close
pairing: adjacent market-day stock quotes only; no return filling across suspensions; same-day index return
eligibility: existing historical BASE_V2 eligible, common finite primary beta / 126 beta / CSI300 beta / 252 volatility / 20 volatility
quintiles: sort raw primary beta ascending, symbol ascending ties, split into 5 near-equal groups; equal stock weights
labels: signal d: close[d+1+h]/close[d+1]-1 for h=5,20; invalid if any interval quote missing; future labels only for evaluation
controls: within-date cross-sectional beta residual on industry dummies, log market cap and volatility; missing controls excluded and coverage reported; diagnostic IC only, no new portfolio
cash_control: common universe stock budget clip(low-beta50 target beta / common target beta, 0, 1), remaining cash zero yield, weekly next-close execution; diagnostic approximate risk matching, no leverage
six_strategies: unchanged existing FIXED K50 historical NAV; target equal-weight beta with missing-weight coverage, not actual held-weight beta; realized rolling beta from full account NAV
interpretation: retrospective already-seen history, not fresh OOS; no optimization or automatic production activation
limitations: provider snapshots not original financial vintages
no lots/minimum fees/stamp tax/limits/full suspension feed/impact
fractional adjusted-price execution; no fills at missing quotes; stale valuation and stranded holdings sensitivity reported
weekly 20-day IC labels overlap; no naive independent-observation t-statistic
no borrowed leverage, shorts or exact BAB replication
